lean.scope: Kernel build of the declared project and public theorem dependency audit. Private lemmas are compiled and checked through their sources/dependents. This does not formalize every manuscript claim, certify novelty, or supply external empirical validation.

limitations: Synthetic finite controls are not a proof of infinite claims.
The six halfspace radii are not an instantiation of the six original predicates.
Positive global calibration radii for the tower are not certified.
R0 necessity, product atomicity and channel-map injectivity remain bounded classical debt.
Independent scientific review and external data are pending.
